text:
Devon: Heads-up — planning a canary deploy for routing-cache fix (release/2.1). Target window tomorrow 10:00 PT. Planning a staged ramp by cohort (internal -> beta -> % ramps). Who can own smoke checks and rollback watch?
Anna: sounds good. can we run external low-volume "beta" before marketplace 5%? less blast radius.
Liam: I can own smoke for internal + beta. will monitor dashboards. what are our abort thresholds?
Priya: Abort if 5xx rate increases >0.5 percentage points for a sustained 5m OR p95 latency +200ms over baseline. Add a synthetic hitting the KV-cache hot path (2 failures = abort).
Devon: locking abort rules: "5xx > 0.5pp for 5m" OR "p95 +200ms for 5m" OR "synthetic 2 consecutive failures". I'll add to rollout doc.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: canary-release/2.1 -> scheduled 2026-04-05T17:00:00Z by Devon.
Anna: smoke checklist I'll run: 1) /health on all nodes 2) generate small prompt to each region 3) tail worker logs for OOMs 4) check token accounting and billing deltas
Liam: tagging @Sofia for rollback readiness — Sofia can you be standby during 17:00-17:20?
Sofia: yep, standby. if we rollback, revert to tag canary-2.0. rollback script is `scripts/revert_canary.sh` (tested locally).
Devon: cohort selection: exclude customers >10k tokens/min, exclude compliance-flagged orgs. Anna to DM product for confirmed list.
Anna: noted. also adding a quick alert to PagerDuty channel for the canary (low-threshold).
Liam: proposed ramp timeline: internal 5m, beta 10m, 1% 10m, 5% 15m, 20% 20m. increment steps: internal -> beta -> 1% -> 5% -> 20%.
Devon: sounds good. final plan: internal (redwood-dev) 5m, beta 10m, 1% 10m, 5% 15m, 20% 20m. rollback immediate on abort.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-04-05T17:00:00Z — cohort: redwood-dev.
Anna: internal smoke passed (health ok, p95 within baseline). proceeding to beta.
Liam: beta smoke failing — seeing a brief 5xx spike. digging into logs now.
Anna: can you paste the errors?
Liam: hitting this repeatedly: `RuntimeError: Encoder OOM at chunk-encoder.cc:234` across 3 workers in 2m. stack traces attached to logs.
Priya: abort. initiating rollback now.
deploy-bot: Rollback started -> reverting to canary-2.0
Sofia: rollback complete. services healthy, all checks green.
Devon: thanks everyone. we'll pause the rollout, open an issue to add encoder memory guards and stronger synthetic coverage, then reschedule next week. :thumbsup:
Anna: I'll follow up with the customer-exclusion list and post the updated schedule in #eng-releases.
